color.note: Three layers: `px-*` sprite palette (fixed), role tokens (`surface`, `ink`, `brand`, ...) that alias it per theme, and control tokens that alias the roles. Read the role or control token in UI code; read `px-*` only in pixel art.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Template input 1 of 5: the page ground. `surface` aliases it; `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` are derived from it. A tenant sets this and the theme template derives the rest.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Template input 2 of 5: the brand color. `brand` aliases it and Bit's body takes it as `accent`. It is a fill, never text: `brand-text` is derived from it for text, and every fill carries the 2px `outline`. Its text color `on-brand` must reach 4.5:1 or the template rejects it.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Template input 3 of 5: the second brand color, teal for drills.pro (Bit's pupil). `lens` and `success` alias it. Text-safe: 4.5:1 or better on all three surfaces in both themes; the template darkens or lightens a tenant's value until it is.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Template input 4 of 5: caution states such as past-due billing, low credits and long queues. Text-safe on all three surfaces; pair it with a triangle glyph. The template adjusts a tenant's value until it reads at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: font-color
tokens.usage: Template input 5 of 5: primary text and icons. `ink` aliases it and `ink-muted`, `line` and `line-strong` are mixed from it toward `background`. 12:1 or better on every surface in both themes; the template rejects values under 4.5:1.

tokens.name: px-ink
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: outline, iris and deep ground. Fixed in both themes. Use inside pixel art and as the source of `ink`, `outline` and `on-brand`; UI code reads the role tokens below.

tokens.name: px-paper
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: the eye white and the light ground. Fixed. Source of `surface` (light) and `ink` (dark).

tokens.name: px-orange
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: Bit's body and the brackets. Fixed. Source of `brand`.

tokens.name: px-orange-dark
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: shadow edge on orange pixels. Fixed. Decorative only: never a text or control color (ink on it is 3.8:1).

tokens.name: px-orange-light
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: highlight edge on orange pixels. Fixed. Decorative only.

tokens.name: px-teal
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: the pupil, sparkle and detection frame. Fixed. Source of `lens` (dark).

tokens.name: px-amber
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: the warning sign. Fixed. Source of `warning` (dark).

tokens.name: px-navy
tokens.usage: Sprite palette: the lowest shade of navy, used for dark-ground dither. Fixed.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `brand-text` read on it in both themes. Aliases the `background` template input.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, inputs and menus sitting on `surface`. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `brand-text` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, code blocks and the empty canvas behind dataset images. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-soft`. 12:1 or better on all four in both themes. Aliases the `font-color` template input.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-soft`. 5.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines, panel edges and table rules. Carries no meaning on its own; use `control-border` for anything that must be found.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons, and icon strokes. 3:1 or better on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 2px pixel outline drawn around every orange fill, as Bit has one. In the light theme it is what makes an orange shape a meaningful mark (about 17:1 on `surface`); in the dark theme the orange fill carries itself and the outline blends into the ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fill for primary buttons, selected markers and brand blocks. Always paired with `on-brand` text. On light surfaces it measures only 2.5 to 2.9:1, so never use it as standalone text or a bare mark: give the shape an `outline` border or use `brand-text`. Aliases the `primary` template input.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `brand`. 6.4:1 or better in both themes. Never white on `brand`.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text, links, thin marks, chart lines and focus-free outlines on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-soft`. 4.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, highlights and callouts. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `brand-text` read on it.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep brand block for covers, hero bands and marketing panels. Lifts to a lighter navy in the dark theme so it separates from `surface` (1.6:1). Text on it uses `on-night`.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `night`. 11:1 or better in both themes. Do not use `surface` here: it flips to ink in the dark theme.

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: Teal accent: the lens and the pupil. Detection boxes, 'seeing' states and focus on model output. Fill or text; 4.5:1 on all three surfaces in both themes. Aliases the `secondary` template input.

tokens.name: on-lens
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `lens` fill. 5.9:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with a 2px offset. Blue on purpose: it never competes with the orange brand. 5:1 or better on all three surfaces and on `brand-soft`. On a `brand` fill it measures 2.2:1, so keep the 2px offset that lifts the ring onto the surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Live endpoints, passed validation. Always with a word or check glyph, never color alone. Text-safe on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed jobs, destructive actions. Text-safe on all three surfaces; pair with an x glyph. Success and danger differ in hue toward blue and in glyph, not red versus green.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Training in progress, informational banners. Pair with a spinner or info glyph.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Background of inputs, selects and checkboxes.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 2px border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3:1 or better on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a selected row, tab or card.

tokens.name: selected-edge
tokens.usage: 2px edge of a selected card or tab. 4.8:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: on-class
tokens.usage: Chip text on `class-1`, `class-2`, `class-3`, `class-5` and `class-6`. Fixed ink, not `ink`, because `ink` turns light in the dark theme while the class colors do not.

tokens.name: on-class-4
tokens.usage: Chip text on `class-4`. Fixed paper.

tokens.name: class-1
tokens.usage: First label class color, from the Okabe and Ito set. Used as box strokes and chips on dataset images, so it is identical in both themes. Chip text is `on-class` (8:1).

tokens.name: class-2
tokens.usage: Second label class color. Chip text is `on-class` (5.4:1).

tokens.name: class-3
tokens.usage: Third label class color. Chip text is `on-class` (14:1).

tokens.name: class-4
tokens.usage: Fourth label class color. The only class chip with light text: use `on-class-4` (4.97:1).

tokens.name: class-5
tokens.usage: Fifth label class color. Chip text is `on-class` (6:1).

tokens.name: class-6
tokens.usage: Sixth label class color. Used last because it sits close to `brand`. Chip text is `on-class` (8:1).

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Pixelify Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero and empty-state headlines only, set in the pixel face. Latin only; Thai headlines fall back to IBM Plex Sans Thai at weight 700.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the console, in the pixel face. Thai titles fall back to IBM Plex Sans Thai.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI and paragraph text. The 24px leading leaves room for Thai tone marks.
styles.sample: Upload photos, draw boxes, and press train.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text and captions.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Endpoint URLs, ids, metrics and API keys.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Inline run ids and class confidences on boxes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One UI pixel: icon-to-label gap, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Two pixels: gap inside buttons, chips and badges; the cover's dither and corner-cut step.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field internal padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing; one sprite grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page-level spacing and hero padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space around a sprite in an empty state.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and splash vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inline code. A 2px corner reads as a pixel bevel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and brand blocks. Never larger: corners stay near-square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and toggles only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards that sit above `surface`: a hard 3px drop with no blur, like a pixel ledge.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: The pressed state of a button: the ledge flips inward.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs: a hard 4px offset in near-black.

border.note: Pixel borders are always whole multiples of the 2px UI pixel; never 1.5px.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel edges drawn in `line`. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-pixel
tokens.usage: Controls, outlined orange fills and selected edges.

tokens.name: border-chunky
tokens.usage: Large decorative frames such as the empty-state card.

pixel.note: Sizes and timing for pixel art. Scale sprites only by whole numbers.

tokens.name: pixel-unit
tokens.usage: The UI pixel. Spacing, borders and corners are multiples of it.

tokens.name: favicon-1x
tokens.usage: The favicon grid at 1x.

tokens.name: sprite-1x
tokens.usage: The Bit and app icon grid at 1x. Never display below 4x except the favicon.

tokens.name: sprite-4x
tokens.usage: Bit in lists-of-one, cards and toasts-of-one; the smallest approved Bit.

tokens.name: sprite-6x
tokens.usage: Bit beside a headline on desktop.

tokens.name: sprite-8x
tokens.usage: Bit as a hero, splash or onboarding sprite.

tokens.name: pixel-step
tokens.usage: One animation frame at 12 frames per second. Delay GIFs and live SVG in multiples of it.

tokens.name: pixel-timing
tokens.usage: CSS timing function for decorative pixel motion: jump, never ease.
